svg.title: A restriction-site SNP changes fragment length
svg.desc: Two DNA cases. The fourth base pair is T/A in A and C/G in B. EcoRI cleavage produces two fragments in A and one longer fragment in B. Product ends show schematic 5-prime overhangs.
svg.metadata: Original vector construction. Source teaching facts and labels: image_002.jpg. Schematic; no measured fragment lengths or intensities.
